maturityAndLiquidity.basis: Dual-source short-duration receivables + Nest primary redemption design: Nest available-vaults nOPAL (snapshot 2026-07-27) describes FX-hedged short-dated Brazilian credit-card receivables via BlackOpal LiquidStone II plus Superstate USCC for liquidity management, redemption estimate T+1, and composition with a liquid-assets sleeve (docs snapshot ~3–4% liquid + nTBILL buffer; live positions API at pin shows ~$0.52M liquid stables + ~$2.07M nTBILL against ~$47.2M NAV). Limited: no numeric WAM/WAL; T+1 is an estimate not a hard SLA; large redemptions can queue while underlying receivables unwind; obligor-level liquidity of the FIDC book is unpublished.
